description: The file is the main entry point for a Flutter mobile application implementing a Tic Tac Toe game with theming, UI layout, game logic, and user interactions.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring the app theme and home page for the Tic Tac Toe game.

classes.name: TicTacToePage
classes.description: Stateful widget managing game state and UI layout for the Tic Tac Toe game.

classes.name: _TicTacToePageState
classes.description: State class implementing game logic, user interaction handling, and UI rendering.

classes.name: _Tile
classes.description: Custom widget representing an individual game tile with tap animation and styling.

classes.name: _TileState
classes.description: State class for _Tile handling tap animations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializing the app by running TicTacToeApp.

methods.name: _oceanScheme
methods.description: Constructs a ColorScheme based on brightness with brand-specific colors for the theme.

methods.name: _buildTheme
methods.description: Builds ThemeData using a color scheme, setting styles for UI components.

methods.name: _restart
methods.description: Resets game state to initial conditions, clearing the board and resetting variables.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Processes user taps on game tiles, placing marks, checking for wins or draws, and updating game state.

methods.name: _isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game ended in a draw.

methods.name: _checkWinner
methods.description: Checks all winning patterns to determine if a player has won; updates winning line.

methods.name: _showResultSnackBar
methods.description: Displays a SnackBar notification indicating game results or messages.

methods.name: _buildBoard
methods.description: Creates the game board UI as a grid of tiles.

methods.name: _Tile
methods.description: Widget representing individual game board tiles with tap animation and styling.

methods.name: _animateTapCancelOrUp
methods.description: Resets tile animation on tap cancel or release.
